pos.personaBrief: Flamengo dominated through the ball (58.49% possession in the Copa do Brasil final 1st leg, Gazeta: prioritises possession, Driblab: dominates through the ball) and also recovered high, while still dropping into a compact low block when needed.

pro.personaBrief: Build-up was patient with a 4v3 backline superiority and wide progression (TFA), but with quick recovery high up and fast, dangerous 1v1 attackers.

est.personaBrief: Narrow 4-3-1-2 diamond with Gabigol and Pedro swapping positions and players deciding in the final third (Lance), so relational with a defined base shape.

lar.personaBrief: Narrow diamond with 82% of xG created through the middle, though width was kept and the opposite fullback was used (TFA).

blo.personaBrief: Two centre-forwards led the high press with PPDA 7.38 and quick recoveries in the opposition half (TFA, Driblab), though it dropped into a low block when required.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal press maintaining structure (TFA) and compact blocks, with some pairing of midfielders on opponents in the press.

pla.personaBrief: Played its own possession-based 4-3-1-2 consistently, but Dorival adapted to the squad he found and was willing to drop into a low block.

res.personaBrief: Dorival's stated view prizes results and trophies (seven wins in seven, two titles), a pragmatic winner's mentality alongside an attacking team.

sis.personaBrief: Dorival leaves the final third decisions to the players (Lance) and relied on stars like Arrascaeta, Gabigol and Pedro, with a collective press from everyone.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, creative stars (Arrascaeta, Everton Ribeiro) with 1v1 dangerous attackers, plus intensity in the press; midfielders like João Gomes valued for passing and energy.

bas.personaBrief: Two teams mixing expensive veterans with young talents (InfoMoney), built through big signings like Vidal and Cebolinha.

lid.personaBrief: Dorival was a conciliatory manager whose squad wanted him to stay (Goal), a harmony-first approach with shared rules.
